Cathedral UI layout checking exceeds its 300-second timeout because resolver bucket selection repeatedly formats and hashes large proof payloads. Select buckets from typed semantic shape and cheap leaf/capture identifiers through the existing ordered child traversal. A match still requires the complete payload, proof context, mode, storage epoch and dependency observations before reuse or recurrence.

This changes the lookup filter. Equal complete payloads select consistent buckets; omitted range and authority detail can only add collisions. StructuralArrivalKey, Debug/polynomial normalization, mathematical meaning and persisted representations remain unchanged. No recipe cache or retained metadata is added.

Fixed base: `9ee60dfdf1f95d4dea2419e1771e781327740368`. Candidate: `d6168fccb67e6073fefedf16c33f2fd4e370dfa0`. Final diff is one checking file.

Validation:

- 16 focused resolution-query tests pass, including observer/mode/authority checks, a deliberate same-bucket/different-range control that must neither reuse proof nor fake recurrence, and storage-epoch separation.
- Independent source acceptance names this candidate and checks equality-to-bucket consistency, ordered children and canonical BigInt handling.
- Earlier optimized producers still timed out on the actual UI command; the text-cache experiment also timed out and is completely removed from the final diff. Its measurements remain attributed to its own producer.

## Summary

Folds the `N_variant_enum_payload_bound` count family (41 folders) into two rows. The standard applied is the boundary rule from #1159: a fact folder must show a twin diagnostic its nearest row lacks, or an emitted form that differs on at least one target.

- **Same sentence and same twins.** Every folder states "matching an N-variant tagged payload whose data `requires` bounds every arm to 40..80 keeps `res` in 40..80". Only N and the case names differ. Every reject twin removes the same call-requires obligation `res >= 40 && res <= 80`, and the tag is one byte at every N up to 44.
- **No emitted form to compare.** On base, only `five` compiles. The six-to-44 local places fail `--check`, so no larger count shows a tag, dispatch or branch boundary.

| Variants | `omega --check` on `local/main.omg` (base) |
|---|---|
| 4 | refused, 5 s |
| 5 | checks, 1 s |
| 6–19 | refused, 5 s → 172 s (8: 9 s, 15: 70 s, 19: 172 s) |
| 20–44 | no result within 180 s |

A native `macos_arm64` compile of `forty_variant_enum_payload_bound/local` ran 35 min 55 s before I stopped it.

**Kept**
- `five_variant_enum_payload_bound`: all ten programs check.
- `four_variant_enum_payload_bound`: the smallest witness of the refusal. Its root and `call_result` places, which carry `ensures result >= 40 && result <= 80` on the extractor, check. Its other seven places, which read the bound through an uncontracted `extract` call, are refused with "cannot prove requires contract for call …".

That refusal dates from #958, which moved the case-local `where` onto the data `requires`. The goldens still say `checked`. I left them as they are rather than record a base failure; the repair is compiler work outside this PR.

**Deleted**
- 39 sample folders (`six` … `fortyfour`).
- 702 pinned fixtures (351 pass, 351 fail).
- 3,237 golden rows and 624 continuation lines.

Historical run records in two sibling READMEs and in `wiki/drafts/measurements` keep the old names.

## Validation

Compiler built at `ba463c24b33` (opt-level 1). These are witness checks only: 36 kept fixtures, 20 kept programs and 18 twins.

- `corpus_gate --filter facts/{four,five}_variant_enum_payload_bound_through` (checked):
  - 36 fixtures: 10 checked, 26 rejected.
  - 8 regressed: `four`'s refused places, the #958 refusal above.
  - 1 rejected without its expected fragment: `four`'s `target_body` twin. It still refuses on the same obligation, but the diagnostic now names `ArmTargetProbe::target_probe` where the pinned fragment says `target_probe`. This is pre-existing; the fixture is unchanged.
  - 1 diagnostics move (`five`'s `target_body` twin) and 1 expected-satisfied move (`four`'s `call_result` twin).
  - Every timing move was `perf_slower`; the machine's load was 119 on 10 CPUs.
- `corpus_gate --both` over the same filter: 18 fixtures run, 10 built, all 10 exiting 0, 8 rejected.
- `omega run --both`:
  - `five`: 10 of 10 places (root plus nine) exit 0 and agree with Terminal Psi.
  - `four`: root and `call_result` exit 0; the other 8 places exit 200 with the refusal above.
- `omega --check` on the 18 twins: 18 of 18 rejected.
- No golden rows were re-recorded; the only golden edits delete rows of removed fixtures.

body:
Constructors can now use an entry equation over executable integer arithmetic to establish their default domain.

Under `requires left > 0 && left <= 60 && value <= 60 && value + left == 60`, `Counter { value: value + 1 }` refused `Counter`'s `requires self.value <= 60` at base `b9a2381a9f2`, though the same facts proved a scalar `ensures result <= 60`. The structural judge stores the equation as the rewrite `value + left -> 60`; its integer-premise index skipped rewrites whose stored side is a scalar operation, and premise projection read only mathematical terms. The equation branch now projects such sides through `integer_value` in their own carrier (each node keeps its formation obligation), and the rewrite table indexes them.

Parent: **CANONICALIZE-SCALAR-RANGE-CONTRACTS** (carrying propositions through construction).

Witness: `samples/cli/facts/coupled_requires_construction`, all nine places plus reject twins (only `left > 0` → `left >= 0` in the constructing machine), pinned under `tests/omega/{pass,fail}/facts/coupled_requires_construction_*`.

Evidence (windows_x86_64, optimized producer on `b9a2381a9f2` + this change):
- 9/9 positives: native exit 0 / Terminal exit 0; 9/9 twins reject with the default-domain diagnostic. All 9 positives refused at base.
- Focused corpus gate: 18 new rows; 122 fail fixtures stating arithmetic equations with proof-refusal expectations: 0 newly accepted. Their 19 pre-existing golden moves: `--compare b9a2381a9f2` → 0 lost, 0 gained.
- `validation` crate unit-test target does not compile at base (`forwarding.rs`, `constants.rs`, untouched here); no unit tests ran.
